questions.question: When Cephas came to Antioch, what did the writer of a letter to early Christians do?
Why did Cephas pull away from eating with the Gentiles after certain men came from James?

answers.text: He was afraid of the circumcision group
He was angry with the Gentiles
He was called back to Jerusalem

questions.question: According to a letter written to early Christians, how is a person made right with God?
In a letter to early Christians, what did the writer say the Son of God did for him?

answers.text: Loved him and gave Himself up for him
Rewarded him for keeping the law well
Sent him to teach the law to the Gentiles
